snippet.title: Quarantine Zone | Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Hello, everyone!

The time to announce the release date has finally arrived! Once again, the road to this moment was an arduous journey for the whole team at Brigada, given that it is our first game, but we are happy to announce that Quarantine Zone: The Last Check has gone gold and is coming out on January 12th, 2026 for 19.99$.

The price is for US and Western Europe, and you will be able to see the regional price on the release date. 

Very soon, we'll be sharing stories on how to run the best checkpoint during the zombie outbreak there is!

More news will follow in the coming weeks ahead of the release, so stay tuned!

Play demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3525400/Quarantine_Zone_The_Last_Check_Demo/

Join Discord:
https://discord.gg/quarantinezonegame
